description: This file defines the `DefaultConnectionConfig` class, which implements the `ConnectionConfig` interface for managing connection-related settings in Ditto's Connectivity service. It includes configuration parameters like timeouts, hostname whitelists/blacklists, supervision, snapshot, acknowledgement, and various protocol-specific configurations (AMQP, MQTT, Kafka, HTTP) relevant for establishing and maintaining service connectivity.

classes.name: DefaultConnectionConfig
classes.description: Immutable class implementing ConnectionConfig, encapsulating connection parameters such as timeouts, hostnames, supervision, snapshot, acknowledgement, and protocol-specific configurations for the connectivity service.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Constructs a DefaultConnectionConfig instance based on provided Config object, reading configuration at the 'connection' path and applying fallback logic.

methods.name: getClientActorAskTimeout
methods.description: Returns the timeout duration for client actor ask operations.

methods.name: getAllowedHostnames
methods.description: Returns the collection of allowed hostnames.

methods.name: getBlockedHostnames
methods.description: Returns the collection of blocked hostnames.

methods.name: getAmqp10Config
methods.description: Returns the configuration for AMQP 1.0 protocol.

methods.description: Returns the configuration for AMQP 0.9.1 protocol.

methods.description: Returns the interval for declaring acknowledgment labels.
